## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check:standards`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm knip` and `pnpm compat:baseline` pass

- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] A changeset is added or extended when a package changes
